Build charts, tables, counters, and dashboards in minutes using Google Analytics, Google Sheets, Excel, CSV files or APIs, and share them instantly. Visualizations are interactive by default, and branding can be tailored with your logo and theme colors. They can then be embedded or shared anywhere, making analytics simple and engaging for every user.

records.name: FlowOps
records.tagline: From workflow to execution, in one place.
records.description: FlowOpFlowOps is a modern process mapping platform built for teams that need more than just visual diagrams. Tools like Miro and Lucidchart help you map workflows, but the execution still lives somewhere else. FlowOps closes that gap by allowing you to embed everything directly inside your workflow steps, including emails, links, files, SOPs, and resources. FlowOps keeps everything in one place so your workflows are actually usable, not just visual.

records.name: Yaqin
records.tagline: Free Quran & Islamic audio. No ads, no subscription.
records.description: Yaqin is a free Quran & Islamic audio app built for the Muslim community — with no ads, no subscription, and no premium tier. Forever. 🎧 Quran recitation with many reciters 📻 30+ live Islamic radio stations 🎙️ Islamic podcasts 📖 Mushaf reader ⬇️ Offline listening 📊 Listening stats & bookmarks Most Islamic apps monetize through ads or subscriptions. Yaqin doesn't. It was built as a contribution to the Ummah, not a business.

records.name: Editable Business Template
records.tagline: Editable Business Template
records.description: An editable business template is a ready-made design that can be easily customized to fit your needs. It allows users to modify text, colors, images, and layouts without starting from scratch. These templates save time and ensure a professional look for presentations, marketing materials, or documents. They are user-friendly and suitable for both beginners and professionals. Editable business templates help maintain consistency and improve overall branding.

records.name: CodeAtlas
records.tagline: See your GitHub repo as a living dependency graph
records.description: CodeAtlas turns any GitHub repository into an interactive dependency graph by analysing real import relationships using AST parsing. Instead of static folder trees or basic diagrams, it lets developers explore codebases visually by clicking through connected files, making it easier to understand how large projects are structured and how different parts of the system relate to each other. Currently supports JavaScript and TypeScript projects, with plans to expand to more languages.

records.name: The Lanyard
records.tagline: Honest conference reviews, by the people who were there
records.description: The conference review site built for attendees, not organizers. Because the best advice on where to spend your time and money comes from someone who already did.

records.name: TIXVOY
records.tagline: Buy Japan concert tickets without a Japanese phone number
records.description: Japan has the world's second-largest live music market, but buying tickets as a foreigner is nearly impossible. What makes TIXVOY different: - No Japanese phone number needed - International credit cards accepted via Stripe - Full interface in English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean - Browse available tickets or post a buying request - Buyer protection on every transaction

records.name: PrepAI
records.tagline: AI mock interviews + resume ATS analysis
records.description: AI mock interviews + resume ATS analysis Most resumes never get seen by a human, ATS software filters them out automatically. PrepAI scores your resume against any job posting, shows you the missing keywords, and gives you specific rewrites to fix it. Then it generates targeted interview questions based on that exact job and gives you scored feedback on every answer. Type or speak your responses. Free to try. No fluff, just prep that actually works. Website: https://prepaiapp.netlify.app

records.name: Ghost Geyser
records.tagline: 23K updates/sec Solana gRPC stream with zero rate limits
records.description: High-performance Solana Yellowstone gRPC stream for MEV bots and trading engines. 23,000+ updates/sec, sub-3ms latency, zero rate limits. Full account streams for Orca, Raydium, Meteora, PumpSwap. Standard Yellowstone protocol — just swap your endpoint. Built by a solo dev who needed faster infra for his own bots. Free 30-min trial available.

records.name: CodeGlass — Evolve Together
records.tagline: Your AI remembers every mistake and never makes it twice.
records.description: Every AI coding session becomes a learning artifact that compounds. Understand what your AI builds. Stop re-explaining your codebase. The loop that makes both of you smarter.

records.name: DevelopFilm
records.tagline: iOS app for film developing and journaling.
records.description: Develop black and white film with confidence using DevelopFilm: iOS darkroom timer, official datasheets, push/pull adjustments, and a development journal.

records.name: Get Early Access — Pulse

records.description: Pulses

records.name: Context.dev
records.tagline: One API to scrape, enrich, and understand the web.
records.description: Context.dev (previously Brand.dev) gives your AI agents and apps real-time access to structured web data, no brittle scraping infrastructure needed. Scrape any URL as clean markdown or HTML, extract brand data (logos, colors, fonts, socials) from any domain, crawl sitemaps, resolve transaction descriptors, and more. Typed SDKs for TypeScript, Python, and Ruby. Trusted by 5,000+ businesses including Mintlify, Daily.dev, Ferndesk.com, and more. Most teams integrate in under 10 minutes.

records.name: YT Organizer — For YouTube Watch Later
records.tagline: Turn your messy Watch Later into an organized Kanban board.
records.description: The YT Organizer browser extension transforms your YouTube "Watch Later" playlist into a customizable, drag-and-drop Kanban board. It enhances productivity by allowing you to add 1,000-character notes to videos, effortlessly hide or delete clutter, navigate using keyboard shortcuts in a native dark mode, and export your data directly to Notion or Obsidian with a single click using Markdown.

records.name: AuRA AI Astrology & Meditation App
records.tagline: Aura AI Astrology & Meditation App is a spiritual companion
records.description: AuRA is different from traditional astrology meditation apps with static database because it is generating all responses specifically for that instant and for that person with features such as natal chart, daily horoscope, tarot, palm reading, scientific breathe exercises and guided meditation sessions. Live voice oracle feature allows users to talk and chat with their spiritual companion and get personalized guidance for their inner journey.

records.name: Sobha Crescent Sector 63A Gurgaon
records.tagline: 3/4 BHK Luxury Residences
records.description: Buy luxury apartments at Sobha Crescent Sector 63A Gurgaon with world-class features, elegant design, and strategic location advantages.

records.name: TheShipStack
records.tagline: Skip the boilerplate. Ship your B2B SaaS on day one.
records.description: TheShipStack is a Next.js starter for B2B SaaS. Ship faster with auth, Stripe billing, multi-tenant workspaces, and RBAC wired up from day one.

records.name: Omniwo
records.tagline: Personalised blood testing and lifestyle data for longevity
records.description: Omniwo is a longevity intelligence platform that combines advanced blood analysis with wearable data to give you a clear picture of your health. Order a blood test, get your results with personalised insights, and track how your lifestyle choices impact your biomarkers over time. No jargon - just clear, actionable steps towards better health.

records.name: MyRecipe
records.tagline: Save recipes from Instagram, TikTok & any website in one tap
records.description: MyRecipe lets you save recipes from anywhere, Instagram reels, TikTok videos, websites, or even photos of cookbook pages. Just share a link or snap a photo, and the app extracts the full recipe automatically using AI. No more screenshotting recipes or bookmarking posts you'll never find again.
